_comment: Per-arm MCP servers staged into each plugin-A/B arm workspace (Cursor shape). Glean read + Atlassian write, both authenticated via the cursor-agent CLI (`cursor-agent mcp login glean_default` / `cursor-agent mcp login atlassian`) so they work in HEADLESS runs — the desktop plugin's OAuth does NOT carry into cursor-agent. The Glean PLUGIN (plugin-glean-vnext-glean) is not listed here; it is toggled by real install/uninstall and gated by scripts/plugin_gate.py.
